Grace Lin: QuantumEdge sent back SOW asking for 65% off first 45 days + waived onboarding + Net60. Need deal desk input.

Taylor Brooks: Account owner: Taylor (AE). Pilot 45 days, estimated 15M tokens/mo. Customer is small but strategic partner.

Omar Khan: Finance policy: >40% pilot discounts require VP-Finance/CFO approval. Net60 increases DSO; require PO or corporate guarantee. Can we offer a structured credit instead?

Grace Lin: Sales prefers simple percent. Suggest counter: 40% off + $2k onboarding credit, Net30. If they insist on Net60, require PO and credit cap.

Omar Khan: Agree. Proposed deal desk counter:
```
Item: Pilot (15M tokens/mo) - list $1,800/mo
Requested: 65% off 45 days + waive $3k onboarding + Net60
Finance counter: 40% off first 45 days + $2k one-time contra credit; Net30 billing. If Net60 required, need PO + VP-Finance approval + $20k credit cap.
```

approvals-bot: Approval ticket APP-5301 created and assigned to Omar Khan + VP-Finance. Link: https://internal/approvals/APP-5301

Taylor Brooks: Sales can accept the finance counter to move quickly. I'll get PO if they push for Net60. Holding execution until APP-5301 resolved.

Grace Lin: Thanks all — updating SOW to reflect finance counter and noting escalation.
